description: Cheaply scan a project's real current state and propose a few DIRECTIONS for advancing it - strategic angles, not task lists. Use this when the user asks something open-ended like "what should we do next?" or "how do we move this forward?" and has not described a specific goal. These are saved as suggested directions only: nothing is created, and no mission, chore or resource comes out of this call. To break one direction down into concrete missions and resources afterwards, the user opens it on the returned reviewUrl and approves each row there. Requires a projectId. On failure, `error.retryable` says whether calling again can help. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#scanProjectDirectionsTool

projectId.description: ID of the project to scan.

name: scanProjectDirectionsTool
